title: Community analysis of wastewater electroactive biofilms at different acetate supply levels
description: Biofilms domesticated from sewage were cultured continuously in L2 and H1 mode for 20 days. To explore the species competition process involved in Geobacter, the biofilm samples were subjected to community structure analysis on day 10 and day 20 respectively.
